prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval grounded RPG LOW RES PIXEL ART location concept, elevated three-quarter cutaway. Coarse square pixel clusters, controlled dark outlines, restrained 3-tone stone timber wool iron, muted earth palette, no smooth painted surfaces or photorealism. No people, no text or labels, no quest UI, no magic, no outcome animation. Daylight. Room/prop geometry is a proposal, not certified collision, official geography, inventory or narrative outcome. Open ordinary return path remains visually distinct. One small dyers water-change shed on DRY ground above a wash-stream, not the existing multi-pipe spillway. Two clearly separate shelves of modest closed dye sacks and plain blank shift tags distinguish work crews without ethnic symbols. Small table holds a FEW separate wage tally sticks. Plain empty wooden bucket beside a covered clean-water tub; no one carries water, no polluted splash, no experiment. A raised dry embankment walkway continues past shed even when low channel access gate is closed. No addresses, private recipe text, cure, culprit verdict, actual shutdown paid or mass expulsion.
